provenance_facts.originality_limit: Externally generated base followed by local editing. This is not a deterministic from-scratch reconstruction of the service output.
provenance_facts.concept_and_science_limit: Generated design references and artistic color/soft-tissue choices are not fossil measurements or scientific evidence of actual coloration.

verdicts.scope: Exact exported GLB, local trunk material/UV/tangent/image integrity and sampled fresh-import renders.
Fold rhythm remains near-periodic; close-up relief is useful but does not establish natural elephant skin or a reference match.

observations_and_limits: 30,454 triangles. Independent records preserve the baseline geometry, original normals, vertex color and winding; this is a local surface change, not a new body-shape revision.
Two embedded 512 x 1024 images add trunk normal/roughness detail. Small GLB byte size is not evidence of browser GPU-memory or frame-time performance.
Pre-v4 failed previews affected by image-repacking problems are excluded from current visual evidence. The retained failure analysis does not prove every historical failure had the same cause.
